docs.title: django-allergens
docs.text:
EU Annex II food allergen vocabulary (+ nickel) for Django, with Filer images, modeltranslation-ready name / slug / description, and an idempotent catalog loader.

Default language is English. Italian translations ship for UI labels, URL path prefixes (allergeni/), and catalog fields.

docs.title: Install
docs.text:
pip install django-allergens

INSTALLED_APPS = [
    "modeltranslation",  # before django.contrib.admin
    # ...
    "easy_thumbnails",
    "filer",
    "mptt",
    "polymorphic",
    "allergens",
]

python manage.py migrate
python manage.py load_allergen_catalog

Wire package URLs inside i18n_patterns so path prefixes translate:

from django.conf.urls.i18n import i18n_patterns
from django.urls import include, path

urlpatterns += i18n_patterns(
    path("", include("allergens.urls")),
)

docs.title: Usage
docs.text:
from allergens.models import Allergen

egg = Allergen.objects.get(slug="egg")
print(egg.name_en, egg.name_it)  # Egg / Uovo
print(egg.slug_en, egg.slug_it)  # egg / uovo

Choice values (icon) are stable English codes; Italian labels live in locale/it. Catalog natural-language fields use modeltranslation (en / it).

URL reverse examples (with LocaleMiddleware + i18n_patterns):

  • English: /en/allergens/egg/
  • Italian: /it/allergeni/uovo/
